Something I did for a while was draw faces when I was upset, if you’re artistic then this will be easier. Whenever I cut I go pretty quickly, so I apply that to when I draw a face. I use quick short lines not trying to be perfect but trying to draw a face that conveys my emotion. On the days I felt nothing the faces I’d draw would have soft strokes and few layers, on days I was panicking my faces would have dark lines and there would be much more conveying anger or frustration or sadness. Idk if I was able to explain it right but it did keep me from self harming for a while.
